name: Teleport PAM
description: Teleport 특권 접근(PAM) 감사 이벤트를 수집하고 활성 세션·사용자를 조회하는 에이전트입니다. 전용 화면이 없어 좌측 메뉴에는 표시되지 않으며, AI 어시스턴트를 통해 질의응답으로 사용합니다.
description_en: Privileged access monitor for Teleport — ingests webhook audit events, queries live sessions and users, and exposes a filtered in-memory event log. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

endpoints.description: Clear all stored audit events (admin only)

env_vars.name: TELEPORT_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Bearer token for Teleport API calls

env_vars.name: TELEPORT_AUDIT_MAX
env_vars.description: Max audit events kept in memory (deque maxlen)

notes: Teleport API calls use verify=False to handle self-signed certificates.
Audit events are stored in a deque — they are lost on restart; use a DB sink for persistence.
POST /audit/events is intentionally unauthenticated — protect it at the network/firewall level.
